function.description: Look up a small-molecule record by PubChem CID (e.g. 2244). Returns cid, name, iupac_name, formula, smiles, molecular_weight (Da), heavy_atom_count and h_bond_donors. Every record includes a _verification field computed by a deterministic checker against the full database entry (sequence/formula recount, taxonomy, reverse lookup); it lists any field whose value could not be confirmed, with the derived value where one exists.

function.name: find_compound_by_name
function.description: Look up a small-molecule record by its common name (e.g. aspirin). Returns the same fields as get_compound. Every record includes a _verification field computed by a deterministic checker against the full database entry (sequence/formula recount, taxonomy, reverse lookup); it lists any field whose value could not be confirmed, with the derived value where one exists.
